title: Listening Drill — Stream flow check
description: Fieldwork briefing. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Stream flow check
sections.transcript:
LEADER: Let me explain how we'll collect data about water flow in the stream. Each pair will have the same instructions. That matters because another group needs to be able to repeat what you've done.

LEADER: Start with the lower reach. Record the first reading at ten. The quantity we're comparing is flow speed. Use the timer marked with blue tape.

LEADER: At the end, make a quick sketch of the stream bank. If you miss a reading, mark it as missing. Don't fill in a number by copying the nearest result.
